```lua
local function getEntityStatements(entity, propertyId, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    local statements = entity.claims[propertyId]

    if propertyId and statements then
        local originalStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        for _, statement in ipairs(statements) do
            if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
                statement["qualifiers"] = nil
                statement["references"] = nil
            end
        end

        local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
            for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(cloneOfStatements) do
                cloneOfStatement["qualifiers"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["qualifiers"]
                cloneOfStatement["references"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["references"]
            end
        end

        return cloneOfStatements
    end

    return statements
end

local function updateStatementTable(actualStatementTable, key, value, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    local statements = getEntityStatements(actualStatementTable, key, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    if statements then
        actualStatementTable[key] = statements -- update original table
```
```lua
    end
end
```

```python
    '8.1': '/etc/helmfile-defaults/mediawiki/release/mw-script-main-{environment}.yaml',
}

# Function to determine the live MW image version based on the selected PHP version and environment
def mediawiki_image(php_version, environment):
    # Replace the '{environment}' placeholder in the release values file path with the actual environment name
    release_values_file = RELEASE_VALUES.get(php_version, '').format(environment=environment)
    
    # Read the release values file to determine the live MW image version
    with open(release_values_file, 'r') as file:
        release_values = yaml.safe_load(file)
    
    # Extract the live MW image version from the release values
    live_mw_image = release_values.get('main_app.image')
    
    return live_mw_image
```

```python
import re

def process_text(text):
    # Define the pattern with named groups
    pattern = r'(?P<namespace>\w+)\s+(?P<params>\w+)\s+(?P<filename>\w+)'
    
    # Search for the pattern in the text
    match = re.search(pattern, text)
    
    if match:
        # Extract the named groups
        namespace = match.group('namespace')
        params = match.group('params')
        filename = match.group('filename')
        
        # Check if the filename is not empty
        if filename:
            # Process the extracted groups
            print(f"Namespace: {namespace}, Params: {params}, Filename: {filename}")
        else:
            print("Filename is empty")
    else:
        print("No match found")
```
